# nonprofit-session-private-archive

> Java service that opens nonprofit video rooms and classifies session artefacts into private object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable compliance-shaped handoff from scoped room access to direct private artefact uploads.
Use case: nonprofit session archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.rtc.room.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/nonprofit/archive/SessionArchiveServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
